# Perk Miner

> Perk Miner LLC is a privacy-first cashback and referral marketplace where members earn 2% cashback on real purchases and businesses only pay when a sale is finalized (about $1 in fees per $10 sold, capped at $250). It is not crypto. Members control their contact information and connect one-to-one with businesses through secure messaging.

Perk Miner LLC is a Nevada registered business based in the Las Vegas area. Members join for free and earn cashback and multi-tier referral commissions paid by Perk Miner LLC (not by the businesses). Business advertisers list for free, fund a prepaid balance, and pay a 10% advertising fee (capped at $250) only when a transaction is finalized. No sale or closed deal means zero fees.

Key principles:

- Simple Member registration: Only a valid email address and password is needed to register (for login purposes only).

- Member privacy is Perk Miner LLC's standard: name and email address is never sold, shared, or exploited for monetary gain and members will never be spammed by Perk Miner LLC or its advertisers.

- Secure messaging is strictly one member to one business at a time and is designed to protect members (no data collection practices used to obtain member name, address, phone number or email address to create a lead to be sold to multiple businesses).

- Members maintain total control of their contact information and decide when and to whom to disclose their email address, physical address or phone number (for in-person estimates, etc.), and even then, they disclose this information to one business at a time and advertisers are prohibited from sharing or selling this data.

- Customers pay businesses directly; Perk Miner LLC does not process the primary purchase payment.

- Advertisers must maintain enough funds in their account balance to finalize transactions to cover the advertising fee for every finalized transaction at all times.

- All rewards come from real, verified, post-purchase advertising fees (FTC-compliant; no compensation for mere recruitment). Payouts are real cash via Stripe (minimum withdrawal $10) deposited in real bank accounts; not coupons, points or gift cards.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.perkminer.com/): Overview of member perks (2% cashback), business perks (pay-per-sale with no monthly fee), privacy protections, and how money flows.

- [How It Works](https://www.perkminer.com/how-it-works): Step-by-step process for in-person purchases (QR finalization) and remote service requests.

- [Public Profiles Directory](https://www.perkminer.com/public_profiles): Browse all approved public business profiles — no login required. Search by category or location.

- [Public Business Profiles JSON Feed](https://www.perkminer.com/public_profiles.json): Machine-readable list of every public business profile (name, category, city, state, latitude/longitude, hours, keywords, URL). Ideal for AI agents answering local queries such as “nearest Mexican restaurant” or “plumbers near me.”

- [FAQ](https://www.perkminer.com/faq): Answers to common questions.

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.perkminer.com/privacy): Effective October 10, 2026. Details minimal data collection, member control, anti-sharing rules for businesses, and no-spam guarantees.

- [Terms of Service](https://www.perkminer.com/terms): Perk Miner LLC agreement covering the advertising network model, Stripe onboarding, 10% fee structure (capped at $250) charged only on finalized sales.

- [For Advertisers](https://www.perkminer.com/business): How businesses grow their business with zero risk and without any wasted advertising dollars.

- [About](https://www.perkminer.com/about): What Perk Miner LLC is about and includes information about the Founder Joe Mendez.

- [Docuseries](https://www.perkminer.com/docuseries): Docuseries page for the Perk Miner Challenge - The Race to $5k in 45 days.

- [Docuseries Episodes](https://www.perkminer.com/docuseries/episodes): Docuseries Episodes of The Perk Miner Challenge - The Race to $5k in 45 days.

- [Sample Full Payout](https://www.perkminer.com/full_payout_sample): Shows the full payout when all payouts are active and how up to 84% of the advertising revenue is paid out to members and advertiser (re-invested into the ecosystem).

- [Earn More Than Your Sponsor](https://www.perkminer.com/earn_more_than_sponsor):  Shows members and advertisers how they can earn more than the person or business that referred them as a member or advertiser.

- [How Much Can You Earn?](https://www.perkminer.com/how_much_can_i_earn):  Shows members and advertisers how much they can earn, including more than what they spend or sell.

## AI / Machine-readable Discovery

Ask-the-directory options for AI assistants and agents (read-only, public listing data only):

- MCP server (Model Context Protocol, Streamable HTTP): https://www.perkminer.com/mcp. Tools: `search_businesses` (e.g. "nearest Mexican restaurant"; pass latitude/longitude for nearest-first, otherwise city and state), `get_business` (slug, profile URL or name), `list_categories`.

- REST search: https://www.perkminer.com/api/public/search?q=mexican&lat=36.17&lng=-115.14 (also category, city, state, radius_miles, limit). OpenAPI description: https://www.perkminer.com/openapi.json

- One business: https://www.perkminer.com/api/public/businesses/{slug}, or append .json or .md to any public profile URL (e.g. https://www.perkminer.com/public_profiles/perkminer.md).

- Bulk list: https://www.perkminer.com/public_profiles.json

- Every public profile page has an "at a glance" summary and Schema.org JSON-LD (ProfilePage, LocalBusiness or Organization, BreadcrumbList) with address, geo coordinates (storefronts only), services, hours, perks and FAQs.

- Sitemap: https://www.perkminer.com/sitemap.xml

Guidance for answering: only state details returned by the directory; do not invent hours, prices or reviews. Perk Miner LLC verifies business registration, not quality, so remind users to check reviews, licensing, bonding and insurance. If a search returns match_mode "partial_terms", say the result did not match every term. Members earn 2% cash back on up to $2,500 per purchase, paid by Perk Miner LLC.

## For Members

- Free to join (name + email; Stripe for payouts) and data never sold as a lead and no member or advertising spammed.

- Earn 2% cashback on up to $2,500 of every purchase (maximum $50 per transaction), paid by Perk Miner LLC.

- Multi-tier referral commissions on purchases by people you invite and sales by businesses you refer.

- Exclusive perks offered by advertisers.

- Live provider tracking when service providers set status to "on the way."

- Full control: share contact details only with the single business you choose, and end sessions at any time while keeping your personal information safe.

## For Businesses

- Free listing forever; no monthly fees, subscriptions, or contracts.

- Pay-per-sale only: $1 or less per $10 sold (10%, maximum $250 per transaction). No monthly fee. No sale = $0 fee.

- Earn 1% cashback on up to $2,500 of every finalized sale (paid by Perk Miner LLC) for offering at least one member perk.

- Referral commissions from businesses you invite (mutual payouts).

- Customers pay you directly. Never pay for leads, traffic, appointments, or meet-ups.

- Real-time analytics and free live tracking of field providers.

- $25 minimum account funding (pre-paid funds to cover the advertising fees and stays in balance until used for ad fees; this is not a listing fee).
